rows.jyutping: ho2 ji5 bei2 ji3 gin3 ge3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to describe a person or group able to give advice.

example.english: This committee is advisory, so you can ask them about policy issues.
example.traditional: 呢個委員會係可以畀意見嘅，遇到政策問題可以問吓佢哋。
